scope: All 219 Radiance records returned by the public Hextech Analytics set:RAD library on 22 October 2026. Includes all numbered base cards 001–167, 40 additional numbered/alternate/showcase printings and 12 rune printings. Completeness is relative to this community source; tokens and any other promotional printings are not claimed complete.
reason: Radiance mechanics and individual card behavior require reviewed engine implementations and tests. Even reprints and runes remain blocked until reviewed.
attribution: Unofficial fan project. Structured records are from Hextech Analytics, not Riftcodex or an official Riot API. Card names, rules text, and Riot CDN artwork are property of Riot Games, Inc.
